title: A neural network “hallucinates” new protein structures
summary: The network predicted about 2,000 new sequences as foldable; over 100 were produced in the lab, and for three, nuclear magnetic resonance and X-ray crystallography confirmed the predicted shapes. Only three proteins were characterized in detail; using the method to create useful functions (drugs, enzymes) is a future goal.
organization: University of Washington Institute for Protein Design
